GOT QUESTIONS?

Everything you need to know

How do I book Alleppey Boat Tour Packages? +

The easiest way is to message us on WhatsApp — we confirm your booking in minutes. You can also use the booking form on any listing page.

What is the difference between a private and sharing houseboat? +

A private houseboat is exclusively for your group with full privacy, personal crew, and customised meals. We also offer budget-friendly shared boathouses where you can book a private cabin while sharing the common areas—great for couples.

Are meals included in the houseboat price? +

Yes! All our Alleppey boat tour packages include authentic Kerala meals — breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner. Meals are freshly prepared by our onboard chef using local ingredients.

What is the best time to visit Alleppey? +

October to February is the best time to enjoy our Alleppey boat tour packages, when the weather is cool and pleasant. March to May is warm but still good. June to September is monsoon season — the backwaters are lush and beautiful, though occasional rain is expected.

Is it safe for children and non-swimmers? +

Absolutely. Safety is a top priority across all our Alleppey boat tour packages. All our boats are equipped with life jackets and safety equipment. Our crew is trained in water safety. Children are welcome and we take extra precautions for families with young kids.

Can I do a same-day booking? +

Yes, same-day bookings are possible depending on availability. WhatsApp us and we will confirm within minutes. We recommend booking at least 1-2 weeks in advance during peak season.

What is your cancellation policy? +

Our cancellation policy depends on the specific service or package you have booked (such as premium houseboats, shikara rides, group kayaking, or speedboat tours). Since each experience has different operational requirements, please refer to the specific cancellation terms provided at the time of your booking. However, we understand that travel plans can change, and we always do our best to be flexible and help you reschedule your trip whenever possible! If you have questions about the policy for a specific package, please feel free to contact our team.

Professional Boat Crew

Every private tour includes an experienced local captain, a chef, and an engine driver dedicated to your safety and comfort.

Safe & Verified Fleet

Our fleet strictly adheres to government regulations. We provide safe docking by 5:30 PM and secure parking at the Alleppey Finishing Point.

Authentic Kerala Cuisine

Enjoy meals prepared fresh on board. From welcome drinks to traditional Karimeen fry and evening tea, your dining experience is fully included.

Looking for a different experience?

Whether you want a short canal ride or a budget-friendly group stay, explore our other premium backwater services in Alleppey.

Shared Houseboats

Enjoy the classic backwater experience on our budget-friendly shared boathouses.

Shikara Rides

Explore the narrow village canals peacefully and get closer to local backwater life.

Speed Boat Cruises

Thrilling, fast-paced rides across the wide open waters of Vembanad Lake.

Kayaking

Paddle at your own pace and experience the tranquility of nature up close.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are houseboats safe for children and infants? + Yes, absolutely! Our houseboats are fully enclosed with safety rails. Our crew is highly trained, and life jackets are available on board for all age groups.
What are the standard AC timings? + For standard Deluxe and Premium packages, the air conditioning in the bedrooms is turned on from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM while the boat is docked for the night.
Do you provide pure vegetarian food? + Yes, we prepare excellent pure vegetarian meals in a clean, separate kitchen area upon request. Please inform us of any dietary restrictions beforehand.
Can the houseboat cruise at night? + No. As per strict Kerala government regulations, all houseboats must dock safely by the riverbank at 5:30 PM. Cruising resumes the next morning at 8:00 AM.

Find Your Perfect House Boat Alleppey (Alappuzha)

Navigating the vast expanse of Vembanad Lake and winding through the intricate network of village canals offers a rare glimpse into the traditional waterfront lifestyle of Kerala. When searching for the best boat house in alleppey, it is crucial to choose verified operators with transparent pricing.

Whether you are planning a quiet romantic getaway or a large family gathering, our diverse alappuzha boat house fleet ranges from comfortable 1-bedroom private boats to expansive 14-bedroom floating venues. Every journey is curated to provide maximum comfort. Check our alleppey boat house price options above, featuring an expert on-board crew and freshly prepared local cuisine, ensuring your backwater cruise is safe, transparent, and entirely memorable.

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.contentHtml:
⚓ Curated Experiences

Welcome to Alleppey Booking.

We partner with Alleppey's finest boat owners and local experts to bring you the absolute best backwater experiences and things to do.

Our Vision

Curating the Best of Alleppey.

What began as a deep-rooted passion for our hometown has evolved into Alleppey Booking. Founded by Abhijith R, our goal is simple: to provide the ultimate Kerala backwater experience by partnering with Alleppey's finest, highest-rated boat owners and service providers.

We don't just offer boat rides; we cover all the best things to do in Alleppey. From the absolute luxury of premium houseboats and the peaceful glide of a kayak, to the adrenaline rush of a speedboat, we have handpicked a network of the best vessels and local teams to make it happen.

By blending modern digital booking convenience with a curated network of local experts, we guarantee a seamless, transparent, and unforgettable journey for every single guest.

100%

Authentic Kerala

The People Behind the Scenes

Our Team & Network

👨‍💻

Abhijith R & Team

Management Team

With a strong background in digital marketing, Abhijith and our dedicated team manage the operations to ensure that from your first click on our website to your final checkout, your experience is smooth, transparent, and professionally handled by our team.

🤝

Our Local Partners

Elite Boat Owners & Crews

We have partnered exclusively with Alleppey's top-rated boat owners, captains, and guides. This strict selection process ensures you are always guided by experienced professionals on safe, well-maintained vessels.

💎

Handpicked Providers

We do the hard work for you. We only partner with service providers who have a proven track record of excellent hospitality and safety.

🦺

Uncompromising Safety

Your safety is our top priority. All vessels within our partner network are government-registered, strictly maintained, and fully equipped.

🌿

Deep Local Roots

Because our network is built purely on local Alleppey operators, you gain access to hidden canals, authentic local dining, and true Kerala culture.

contact.contentHtml:
🎧 24/7 Local Support

We'd love to hear from you.

Whether you have a question about booking a houseboat, customizing a backwater itinerary, or need immediate assistance, our Alleppey team is ready to help.

We are 24/7 available for helping you.

SUPPORT & CONTACT

How can we help you?

What is the quickest way to get a response? +

Messaging us directly on WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach our team. We typically respond within minutes to answer questions or confirm your bookings.

Who do I contact on the day of my cruise? +

Before your trip, we will provide you with the direct contact details of your boat captain (like our pro rider, Akshay). Your dedicated 3-person crew—captain, cook, and engine driver—will be waiting to welcome you upon arrival.

Where is the boarding point located? +

Because we manage multiple boats across the Alleppey backwaters, your specific boarding point will depend on your package. We will send you the exact Google Maps location via WhatsApp once your booking is confirmed.

Can I request a custom menu or mention dietary restrictions? +

Yes! Since your meals are prepared fresh by your onboard cook, we can easily accommodate vegetarian, vegan, or specific dietary requests. Just let us know when you message us to book.

How do I modify or cancel an existing booking? +

To change your travel dates or upgrade your package, simply reply to your original booking confirmation on WhatsApp. We are flexible and will do our absolute best to adjust your itinerary.

terms-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
terms-conditions.contentHtml:
Legal Information

Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before booking your backwater experience with Alleppey Booking.

Last Updated: June 2026

1. General Booking & Payments

Welcome to Alleppey Booking (alleppeybooking.com). By accessing our website and booking our services, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.

  • Prepaid Bookings: All bookings require an advance payment to confirm the reservation. For certain services like Shared Boathouses, payments are 100% prepaid. Any remaining balances must be paid in full at the time of check-in before boarding.
  • Identification: All adult guests must present a valid Government-issued ID (Passport, Aadhar Card, Driving License, or Voter ID) at the time of check-in.
  • Partnership Model: Alleppey Booking partners with elite boat owners and operators. While we guarantee the standard and quality of your booking, the physical operation of the boats is managed by our vetted local partners.

2. Houseboat Timings & Cruising Rules

To comply with local authorities and ensure a smooth experience for all guests, strict timings are enforced for all Houseboat stays (Private and Shared):

  • Check-in Time: 12:00 PM (11:30 AM - 1:00 PM for Shared Boathouses). Management is not responsible for delayed boarding due to late arrivals.
  • Check-out Time: Strictly 9:00 AM.
  • Government Night Halt Rule: As per Kerala Government regulations, no backwater cruising is permitted after 5:30 PM. The boat will be safely docked near a village for the night.
  • Air Conditioning: In Deluxe Houseboats, AC in the bedrooms operates exclusively from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Daytime AC usage requires a supplementary charge of ₹2000/- per room.

3. Child Policy & Extra Guests

  • Children below 5 years of age are complimentary when sharing a bed with parents.
  • Children above 5 years of age are considered extra persons and will be charged at standard rates.
  • Any extra food requirements or changes in the set menu must be communicated to our team at least 1 day prior to check-in.

4. Cancellation & Refund Policy

  • Cancellations made 30 days or more prior to the check-in date will receive a 90% refund.
  • Cancellations made 15 to 29 days prior to the check-in date will receive a 50% refund.
  • Cancellations made within 15 days of the check-in date will receive no refund.
  • Company-Initiated Cancellations: In the rare event that we must cancel your booking due to severe weather, technical issues, or other unforeseen circumstances, we will inform you immediately and provide a full refund of your advance payment.

5. Safety & Liability

Safety is our uncompromising priority across all our partnered services.

  • Life Jackets: Wearing provided life jackets is mandatory for activities like Speedboats, Kayaking, and Shikara rides.
  • Captain's Authority: The Boat Captain reserves the right to alter the route or cancel cruising in the event of severe weather, technical issues, or safety concerns. Guests must follow the instructions of the crew at all times.
  • Personal Belongings: Guests are entirely responsible for their own personal belongings and valuables. Alleppey Booking and its partners are not liable for any lost, damaged, or stolen items during your trip.

  • Partnership Model: Alleppey Booking partners with elite boat owners and operators. While we guarantee the standard and quality of your booking, the physical operation of the boats is managed by our vetted local partners.

2. Houseboat Timings & Cruising Rules

To comply with local authorities and ensure a smooth experience for all guests, strict timings are enforced for all Houseboat stays (Private and Shared):

  • Check-in Time: 12:00 PM (11:30 AM - 1:00 PM for Shared Boathouses). Management is not responsible for delayed boarding due to late arrivals.
  • Check-out Time: Strictly 9:00 AM.
  • Government Night Halt Rule: As per Kerala Government regulations, no backwater cruising is permitted after 5:30 PM. The boat will be safely docked near a village for the night.
  • Air Conditioning: In Deluxe Houseboats, AC in the bedrooms operates exclusively from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Daytime AC usage requires a supplementary charge of ₹2000/- per room.

3. Child Policy & Extra Guests

  • Children below 5 years of age are complimentary when sharing a bed with parents.
  • Children above 5 years of age are considered extra persons and will be charged at standard rates.
  • Any extra food requirements or changes in the set menu must be communicated to our team at least 1 day prior to check-in.

4. Cancellation & Refund Policy

  • Cancellations made 30 days or more prior to the check-in date will receive a 90% refund.
  • Cancellations made 15 to 29 days prior to the check-in date will receive a 50% refund.
  • Cancellations made within 15 days of the check-in date will receive no refund.
  • Company-Initiated Cancellations: In the rare event that we must cancel your booking due to severe weather, technical issues, or other unforeseen circumstances, we will inform you immediately and provide a full refund of your advance payment.

5. Safety & Liability

Safety is our uncompromising priority across all our partnered services.

  • Life Jackets: Wearing provided life jackets is mandatory for activities like Speedboats, Kayaking, and Shikara rides.
  • Captain's Authority: The Boat Captain reserves the right to alter the route or cancel cruising in the event of severe weather, technical issues, or safety concerns. Guests must follow the instructions of the crew at all times.
  • Personal Belongings: Guests are entirely responsible for their own personal belongings and valuables. Alleppey Booking and its partners are not liable for any lost, damaged, or stolen items during your trip.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.contentHtml:
Data Protection

Privacy Policy

Learn how Alleppey Booking collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our services.

Last Updated: June 2026

1. Introduction

At Alleppey Booking (accessible via alleppeybooking.com), one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors and guests. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information that is collected and recorded by us and how we use it to provide you with seamless backwater experiences.

2. Information We Collect

To successfully process your bookings and ensure a safe trip, we collect the following personal information:

  • Contact Information: Your name, email address, and phone number provided during inquiries or the booking process.
  • Identification Details: As mandated by local law, we require Government-issued ID proofs (such as Aadhar Card, Passport, or Driving License) for all adult guests prior to or at the time of houseboat check-in.
  • Booking Data: Information regarding your travel dates, group size, and dietary preferences required for customized meal preparations on board.
  • Website Usage Data: Non-personally identifying information such as browser type, referring site, and the date/time of your visit, collected via cookies to help us improve our website performance.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:

  • Process your bookings and confirm reservations for houseboats, speedboats, and other services.
  • Communicate directly with you via email or WhatsApp regarding boarding points, check-in timings, and itinerary updates.
  • Comply with local Kerala government and tourism authority regulations (specifically regarding overnight guest registries).
  • Improve, personalize, and expand our website and marketing efforts.

4. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal data to third parties. However, to fulfill your requested services, we must share specific details with our trusted partners:

  • Local Boat Owners & Crew: We share your basic contact info, group size, and dietary requirements with the captain and chef assigned to your vessel to ensure they are prepared for your arrival.
  • Legal Authorities: We may disclose your identification documents to local authorities if required by law for security and registration purposes.

5. Data Security

We take the protection of your data seriously. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to secure your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, please be aware that no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

6. Your Privacy Rights

You have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you. You may also request that we correct any inaccurate information or delete your personal data, provided it is no longer required for legal or operational compliance related to a past booking.

7. Contact Us

If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Email: info@alleppeybooking.com

Phone / WhatsApp: +91 7012761588

Office: Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala, India
